section_text_infrastructure_body2.name: section_text_infrastructure_body2
section_text_infrastructure_body2.default: 'AFSL is engaged in providing forensic examination services, scientific analysis, practical training, and internship programs in various disciplines of forensic science. Our laboratory undertakes the examination of forensic evidence and case related materials using appropriate scientific methods, established examination procedures and professional documentation practices.'

section_text_vision_body.name: section_text_vision_body
section_text_vision_body.default: 'Our vision is to establish a leading hands-on training facility where forensic science is brought to life through practical, real-world applications. We aim to equip students and professionals with essential operational skills, a scientific mindset, and a strong ethical foundation necessary for contemporary forensic practice. Our objective is to bridge the gap between theoretical education and field application by providing immersive experiences, including laboratory work, autopsy visits, and actual crime scene investigations. By fostering curiosity, critical thinking, and professional discipline, we seek to cultivate the next generation of forensic experts capable of making meaningful contributions to the justice system. We aspire to serve as a national centre for experiential forensic education, emphasising learning rooted in reality and driven by purpose.'

section_text_mission_body.name: section_text_mission_body
section_text_mission_body.default: 'The mission of Applied Forensic Science Laboratory (AFSL) is to provide reliable, scientific, and practical forensic services that support investigations, organisations, legal professionals, and other stakeholders. We undertake forensic work across areas such as Fingerprint Examination, Questioned Documents, Crime Scene Investigation, Digital and Cyber Forensics, and other forensic disciplines, with a focus on accurate examination, proper evidence handling, objective analysis, and clear reporting. We also provide practical forensic training and internship opportunities for students, interns, and professionals through laboratory work, field visits, autopsy visits, crime scene exposure, case-based learning, and expert guidance. We are committed to creating a professional environment where forensic services and practical learning go hand in hand, strengthening forensic skills, promoting scientific and ethical practices, and contributing to evidence-based investigation and the effective delivery of justice.'

form_subtitle.name: form_subtitle
form_subtitle.default: 'Submit your registration details and payment confirmation information. This form is dynamic and can be adjusted from the admin CMS based on event requirements.'

default_instructions.name: default_instructions
default_instructions.default:
'Please enter your Full Name, College/Institution Name, Course Name, and College Location exactly as you want them to appear on your certificate. No changes will be made later.

• Provide a valid Email ID and Phone Number to receive confirmation and program updates.
• Double-check all details for correct spelling and proper format before submitting the form.
• Registration fees are strictly non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances.
• Upload or provide a valid payment proof (screenshot/transaction ID) if required for verification.
• Submit only one registration per participant. Multiple entries may lead to disqualification.
• Ensure you complete your registration before the deadline to confirm your participation.
• All communication regarding the program (joining link, updates, instructions) will be shared via Email/WhatsApp.
• Participants are expected to maintain professional conduct and discipline throughout the program.
• Certificates will be issued only after successful participation/attendance as per the program guidelines.'
